verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability documents alerting rules and says alerts can be extended with notifications to 'services or third-party incident management systems.' Nothing in the pack documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks that could trigger automated remediation or agents. A generic notification-to-services claim does not meet the webhook bar, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
